[[Júbilo Iwata]] have spent only 2 seasons in J2 after their first relegation from the [[J1 League]] in 2013 after 20 seasons. Third-placed [[Avispa Fukuoka]] won the promotion playoffs and will return to the first division after playing in the J2 for four years. [[Matsumoto Yamaga FC|Matsumoto Yamaga]] were relegated from the J1 immediately after their inaugural promotion. [[Shimizu S-Pulse]] also suffered their first relegation to the J2 after 23 seasons in the J1, while [[Montedio Yamagata]] returned after one season. On the other end of the table, [[Renofa Yamaguchi FC|Renofa Yamaguchi]] have been promoted from the [[2015 J3 League]] as the champions of the second season of the J3 League, replacing [[Tochigi SC]] and becoming the first club based in [[Yamaguchi Prefecture]] to play in the second tier since [[Eidai SC]] back in [[1973 Japan Soccer League#Second Division|1973]]. J3 runners-up [[FC Machida Zelvia|Machida Zelvia]] were also promoted by beating [[Oita Trinita]] in the promotion-relegation playoffs.
